verdict.rationale: Capacities' export docs say properties become front matter values and collections become CSV files. They describe exports as fully human- and machine-readable, and automated full exports can be scheduled, which together let a researcher keep a regularly refreshed, vendor-independent archive. Missing for 10: the export docs never explicitly name Markdown (it is only implied by front matter), no JSON export format, no documented treatment of links/blocks/media in exports, and no independent or hands-on corroboration that exports are complete.
